decisions.reason: As a prominently presented but somewhat electronics-intensive variation on a traditional item, we would keep it while demand still seems plausible, though its non-core complexity raises some exit risk.
This product fits our core Christmas-pyramid craftsmanship closely and is inexpensive to continue offering relative to the option value of another selling season.
Because it was presented as a flagship direction and supported by complementary add-ons, we would keep the platform on the market unless results clearly turned disappointing.
The second edition and dedicated presentation suggest the product concept was gaining traction, and as a complement to the music-box platform it is cheap to keep open.
This seasonal accessory is narrower than the core platform but still offers low-cost variety that supports the electronic music-box line, so we would retain it for now.
A themed Christmas pyramid remains strongly within our established craft tradition, and once developed it can stay in the assortment at relatively low ongoing cost.
